core_meaning.primary_meaning: Izma corresponds to the Arabic form عظمة and is glossed in this record as “Greatness, grandeur, majesty.” The record associates the form with root ع ظ م (ʿ-ẓ-m). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Izma corresponds to the Arabic form عظمة (Arabic root ع ظ م (ʿ-ẓ-m); عَظَمَة (ʿAẓama)). Its core sense is greatness, grandeur, majesty. Izma is Arabic عَظَمَة (ʿAẓama) 'greatness, grandeur, majesty', from the root ع ظ م (ʿ-ẓ-m). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave عزما (a different form) and glossed the name 'Mother of a lion'; the correct form is عَظَمَة.

persian.name: عظمت
persian.long_meaning: Izma (عظمت) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن عظمت، بزرگی، جلال است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

arabic.name: عظمة
